races.paceDynamic: Rahmi will set a genuine pace from the front with Fort Vega, Bella Isabella and City House tracking close behind in the early stages. The large field of 17 runners means those breaking slowly will face traffic problems and need significant luck in running. With most runners showing prominent tendencies and limited hold-up types, the pace should be solid but not suicidal through the first half-mile. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good early positions, as late closers like Sir Les Patterson and Go Athletico will struggle to make ground from the back in such a competitive handicap.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Rahmi, Fort Vega and Bella Isabella all commit early and maintain a strong gallop.
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the field and favour horses with tactical speed who can sit handy without being caught wide. Those with proven stamina at the trip will come to the fore in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Rahmi settles into a more conservative rhythm with the prominent pack content to wait.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and a turn of foot matter most in the final two furlongs. Higher-rated horses with acceleration will have the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and tie up in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: Late runners who can pick up the pieces will benefit from the pace setup, though they still need significant luck in the big field. The pace will have done the damage to most of the prominent racers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If there's significant early scrimmaging or multiple horses get badly hampered.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where position and luck matter more than ability, potentially throwing up a surprise winner. Those drawn favourably or getting clear runs will have huge advantages.

watchPoints.text: Rahmi must lead cleanly from the gates as any early interference could compromise his front-running tactics in the big field.

The two hold-up horses Sir Les Patterson and Go Athletico both need the pace to be strong to have realistic winning chances.
First-time headgear on City House, Gleneagle Bay and Engines On suggests their connections expect improved efforts.

races.paceDynamic: With Khafar as a non-runner, this race loses its main pace angle and becomes a tactical affair where early positioning will be crucial. The field is dominated by hold-up horses with only occasional prominent runners, meaning someone like Grande Cuvee or McHenry Sunrise may need to show more early speed than ideal. In a 5f sprint with 16 runners and limited natural pace, those able to break well and secure good early positions will have a significant advantage. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can sit handy rather than pure hold-up horses who may get caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and runners with tactical speed secure good positions
scenarios.body: Those able to sit prominent or midfield with clear runs will have the jump on purely hold-up horses in the final furlong. The lack of genuine pace-setters means positioning trumps pure finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the large field and moderate pace creates a bunched finish with traffic problems
scenarios.body: Late runners get hampered while those who committed earlier or found rail runs prosper in a messy finish. Pure hold-up horses suffer most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Materializes
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses go forward early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: This would set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to close late with their preferred strong gallop to aim at. The 5f distance becomes less of a concern with genuine pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Inexperienced Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomers possess superior natural ability
scenarios.body: Riot Star or Osterode could have the raw talent to overcome tactical disadvantages through pure speed. Their lack of experience becomes irrelevant with a simple forward ride.

races.paceDynamic: Keke stands as the only confirmed front runner and will control proceedings from the rail, setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. The prominent runners Erosandpsyche, Kendall Roy, Eclairage and Gazelle d'Or will track close behind in the early stages, while the hold-up quartet of Oh Cecelia, Billie Be Quick, Fregada and Likedbymike will be anchored towards the rear. With minimal pace pressure and a short 5f sprint, this tactical shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position handy and kick, as they avoid both the pressure of making the running and the traffic complications that hold-up horses face over this minimum distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses successfully stalk Keke and deliver their challenge in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The handy runners get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses struggle for room and time. Kendall Roy, Eclairage or Gazelle d'Or benefit from perfect tactical positioning behind the uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Keke's uncontested lead proves insurmountable and he sustains his effort to the line
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms completely, while late closers find the winner has gone beyond recall. Keke justifies his higher rating with tactical supremacy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard chasing Keke and sets up the race for a closer
scenarios.body: The early battle between leader and trackers creates the perfect scenario for a swooping finish. Oh Cecelia's class and light weight or Likedbymike's recent form enables them to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unfancied runners finds significant improvement or the favourites underperform
scenarios.body: A horse with hidden form or improved fitness capitalizes on a falsely run race or others' below-par efforts. Billie Be Quick's trainer hitting form or Fregada's step back in trip could provide the upset.

races.paceDynamic: Cuban Grey will force the pace from the front with Sarahmae, Fox In Flight, Treasured Royal, and Nouvel Espoir all keen to race prominently in the early stages. This creates a compressed field with multiple horses vying for forward positions, likely establishing a solid gallop that will test stamina over this sharp 5f trip. The pace pressure from prominent runners Cuban Grey, Sarahmae, and Fox In Flight should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly. This pace dynamic clearly favours horses with hold-up running styles who can produce late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine with Cuban Grey, Sarahmae and Fox In Flight all going forward
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will soften up the pace-setters and allow closers like Lamar Canyon, Genesis and Beauty Queen to unleash finishing kicks. These hold-up horses can pick off tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can find cover and kick clear
scenarios.body: Treasured Royal or Happy Henry could stalk the early pace and have enough left to hold off late challengers. Their tactical speed gives them options if the pace becomes unsustainable.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Cuban Grey and the prominent runners go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where any horse with reserves can win regardless of position. Fresh finishers and those who get good splits benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Cuban Grey gets an easy lead without pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow and Cuban Grey can dictate terms and kick clear when challenged. This unlikely scenario requires the prominent runners to be unusually restrained.

races.paceDynamic: Sparan Nua is the standout pace angle, having shown early speed in both career wins and likely to dictate terms from the front. With most rivals showing prominent tendencies rather than genuine pace-pressing qualities, she should get an uncontested lead through moderate fractions. The lack of confirmed pace pressure will allow the front-runner to control the tempo, while the prominent runners like Nyra, Beset, and Perfect Your Craft settle just behind in the slipstream. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and those who can track the pace closely, as the sustained gallop over 1m4f will expose hold-up horses like Ice Dancer who need a stronger tempo to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Sparan Nua gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: Her superior rating (OR 120) and perfect record will prove decisive as she controls the race from pillar to post. The moderate pace suits her stamina reserves while exposing those needing a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners like Nyra, Beset and Perfect Your Craft engage early and press Sparan Nua.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will suit the proven Group-class performers who can sustain a strong gallop. Sparan Nua's inexperience at this level may show under sustained pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawling affair through halfway.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the 3-year-old weight allowance and tactical speed become crucial. Hold-up horses get their optimal scenario with plenty to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Improver
scenarios.trigger: If the layoff horses Bosphorus Rose or the lightly-raced types find significant improvement.
scenarios.body: Fresh legs and untapped potential overcome class disadvantage in a moderately-run race. The good going suits those returning from breaks.

races.paceDynamic: Clonbun will take this field along at a sustainable gallop from the front with no obvious pressure from the 14-runner field dominated by hold-up horses. With only one confirmed pace-setter and 11 of 14 runners employing hold-up tactics, the early fractions will be comfortable rather than demanding. The lack of early speed will create a bunched field turning for home, setting up a cavalry charge finish where positioning and stamina become crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, as the modest early pace will allow closers to get competitive positions without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Clonbun gets an uncontested lead and dictates terms throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to control the race completely, with his recent Curragh win proving he can sustain a gallop when allowed easy fractions. The hold-up brigade get caught flat-footed when he kicks clear approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The modest gallop suits the hold-up horses with the best finishing kicks, allowing them to unleash late runs from ideal positions. Cisterna's recent Cork win and Bear Right's Leopardstown third give them proven finishing speed for this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates traffic problems and positioning becomes crucial in the straight
scenarios.body: Those held up horses drawn well and ridden positively benefit from avoiding the inevitable scrimmaging behind the modest pace. Hambelton's David Marnane stable form and Bear Right's recent consistency suit this messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite-dominated finish allows a big-priced horse to slip through unnoticed
scenarios.body: The focus on the higher-rated hold-up horses creates gaps for an improving type like Push Harder, whose recent Clonmel third shows building form. The sustainable pace helps lower-rated horses stay competitive longer than usual.
